column1: # `drowning-audio` with the frigate's hull at one, so the sea gets a chance
# to sink it before an encounter boards.
# Measured 2026-10-14 over 27 runs of `drowning-audio`: 9 encounters fired,
# and every one boarded. A boarded frigate leaves the party in deck combat,
# where the remaining scripted `Up`/`Down` keys only walk the Avatar around
# the deck, so the hull never reaches zero and `vehicles.md §6`'s drowning
# rung - and `audio.md §8.9`'s long descent with it - was never reachable.
# The seed differs from `seed-drowning-audio` in one byte: the player
# Any hull damage at all then lands on the last rung. Whether the stock
# game's ranged attacks or rough seas reach the hull before a boarding is
# what this measures; a run that ends in deck combat or with the ship intact
# The engine's own cue is compared offline, as in `drowning-audio`:

column4: DOSBox: sail until something sinks the ship
